fixtures.name: Self-feeding decider latch
fixtures.purpose: Preserve a decider-combinator latched on by its own red-wire self-feedback.
fixtures.invariant: The decider-combinator's red output network carries signal-S = 1 from its own feedback. This holds on any world that has RUN, and since revision 3 it also survives a transfer: the output register itself is not script-writable (see note), but the post-activation latch re-arm pass (module/import_phases/latch-rearm.lua, circuit-latch-rearm R3) re-derives it by forcing the captured condition true for one evaluated tick and restoring it. The destination board asserts the transferred latch arrives ARMED.

fixtures.name: Held-item capacity on a less-researched destination
fixtures.purpose: Preserve a frozen legendary bulk-inserter whose hand is seated with 8 railgun-ammo under a baked >=11 player-force bulk-inserter capacity bonus - the adversarial state for dest-force research replication on import.
fixtures.note: Script-built by tests/lab-gallery/seed-prep-ops.lua (build_inserter_held) onto the stamped inserter-held-capacity cell at (92,8): raise the player force bulk_inserter_capacity_bonus to >=11 (raise-only, logged), create a legendary bulk-inserter at (98.5,13.5), seat 8 LEGENDARY railgun-ammo via plain held_stack.set_stack (no active toggle; inserter-lab B6), then freeze (active=false, destructible=false). Re-baked 2026-07-18: the original bake seated a NORMAL-quality stack and self-certified via the entity-quality meter (B7 run 1b caught it via the independent stack-quality read); the stack is now legendary and both meters read the STACK. forceBulkBonus is a placeholder floor; the live bake pins the exact baked value. The ADVERSARIAL destination state is baked too (2026-07-18): the golden dest descends from the long-lived local host-2 lineage whose player force had bulk 11 / stack 3 (B7 run 1 caught it — the fixture could not discriminate the pre-hydration dest-force bonus-sync fix), so both inserter bonuses were zeroed at bake time and the dest artifact re-pinned; the runner still ASSERTS 0 at load, never forces.
fixtures.invariant: Bulk inserter over railgun-ammo (legendary): held count bounded by the force capacity bonus (0..8 - a live hand legitimately reads empty mid-swing; >8 fails), destructible false, and force.bulk_inserter_capacity_bonus exactly 11 (the MECHANISM of the measured held-loss class: an under-researched dest force clamps hands). Held ITEM IDENTITY and QUALITY are not board-read on a live world (an empty mid-swing hand has no name to read); they are enforced by the exact gate, whose census counts held items quality-keyed - a hand arriving as the wrong item or quality fails the transfer itself (review 2026-07-30).

testCard.law: Held items seat IN FULL on a less-researched destination: export captures the source-force inserter bonuses, import replicates them raise-only, and the strict gate counts the complete state (Pitfalls #28 count-a-complete-state / #29 dest-force research).
testCard.build: lab-omnibus-state-v1 inserter-held-capacity cell (34,-128): a legendary bulk-inserter at (98.5,13.5) holds 8 railgun-ammo via plain held_stack.set_stack (no active toggle); the player force bulk_inserter_capacity_bonus is baked >= 11; the inserter is frozen (active=false, destructible=false).
testCard.action: Production /transfer-platform of the omnibus platform to a destination whose bulk_inserter_capacity_bonus is 0 (asserted, never forced).
testCard.expected: A forceDataMismatches warning fires; the destination bonus is raised, never lowered; the hand seats 8/8 by physical count; the strict gate reports SUCCESS.
testCard.forbidden: An under-seated hand; a gate pass over a short hand; any destination bonus lowered; the baked bonus not surviving save/load.

fixtures.name: Combined belt omnibus (steady-state, hand-built)
fixtures.purpose: One pad combining sideloads, 3 splitters, 3 underground pairs, and 2 filtered output loaders - the CONSERVATIVE closed-circuit exemplar: 380 items recirculate forever with no source and no sink, so any loss is visible instead of self-healed.
fixtures.owningRunnerWaiver: Hand-built live by the owner 2026-07-19 (construct-once doctrine). No build script exists by design; the state itself is the artifact, banked in the source-of-truth checkpoint.
fixtures.invariant: CONSERVATIVE closed circuit (owner removed the infinity chests 2026-07-19: self-healing masks loss): 380 items stationary across 35 turbo belts / 3 splitters / 6 underground ends / 2 filtered loaders; every stack one item; corner inside lanes carry the over-pack class.
